title: KINGSTON WEARS JOCKEY SADDLE CHASES COYOTES
topic: KINGSTON WEARS JOCKEY SADDLE CHASES COYOTES
caption:
Jo Koy describes Kingston's Halloween saddle harness with a jockey doll, and how the dog ran off to chase coyotes for three days. From
Blue in the Face, on Netflix

clip.why: Absurdist visual storytelling peaks when the elderly dog bolts in a jockey costume mid-Halloween.
clip.creator: Jo Koy: Comedy Special
